run_convert_to_imagefolder: run the script to convert image-text pairs into a metadata.jsonl file for dreambooth training
run_convert_with_custom_column: run the script with a custom caption column name instead of the default 'prompt' column
run_validate_input_path: run the script to validate that the input path exists before processing image-text pairs
run_match_captions_to_images: run the script to match .txt caption files with corresponding image files by stem name
run_generate_metadata_jsonl: run the script to generate a metadata.jsonl file from paired image and caption files
